title: macOS 27.3 beta warns if an app would get full device control, nudging users to "Choose Apps" for the app to control instead, brought on by AI apps' popularity (Juli Clover/MacRumors)
summary: Juli Clover / MacRumors: macOS 27.3 beta warns if an app would get full device control, nudging users to “Choose Apps” for the app to control instead, brought on by AI apps' popularity — With the latest macOS 27.3 beta, Apple is giving Mac users more control over the data they share and the access they give to apps …
